title: One book of family recipes
description: Collecting favorite meals with your own corrections and passing them into the plan and the shared shopping list.

blocks.text: Someone gathers recipes from different places into one book and leaves their own corrections. The original entry and the family version stay distinct: changing the servings or an ingredient does not mean copying the whole recipe again.

quote.text: Any recipe in any form, website, social media, cook book or handwritten from your grandmother gets imported correctly and seamlessly.

blocks.text: Your own version of a favorite meal

It is worth starting with a few familiar ways of importing and a clear manual edit. After an import the ingredients and the steps have to be checked, especially when the source was a video or a handwritten note; praise from one author does not guarantee that any material will be recognized.
Keeping the link to the shopping

The book becomes more useful when the meals chosen carry over into the menu and the shopping list. Without that link it turns into one more store of bookmarks, and the main work of getting dinner ready stays with the user.
